items.text: There's a very big perk to spending a day at Las Vegas' notorious Circus Circus
items.article: Hidden behind the casino and hotel, Las Vegas' only indoor theme park, Adventuredome, is an absolute delight. I’ve never stayed at Circus Circus , but I’ve loved it from the minute I walked underneath the oversized chandelier hanging from the glowing porte cochere. Nostalgia oozes from every corner of the ultrakitschy casino at the north end of the Las Vegas Strip, including enormous neon clown signs ripped from a bygone era of Vegas . The place hosts live circus acts, and the whole property is bathed in pink and white, everywhere you turn. It all adds up to the perfect combination of history and showmanship for me. I love it for the same maximalist reason I love the Madonna Inn and the Cabazon dinosaurs : If you look hard enough, you can really get a sense of what it was like in its glory days. As an unapologetic theme park person , I’d had Circus Circus’ Adventuredome on my list for a long time. The indoor amusement park, under a gleaming pink dome behind the main casino and hotel tower, is an anomaly in Las Vegas . Yes, the city has other thrill rides like the Big Apple Coaster at New York-New York, but none of them requires you to walk through a midway with trapeze artists swinging overhead to get there. But as much as I might love the maximalism and retro charm of Circus Circus, the reality is that its reputation is … mixed . Would Adventuredome be a relic of a bygone Vegas? items.key: ai:i'm a former flight attendant. here are 9 things i wish passengers would stop doing on airplanes.
items.text: I’m a former flight attendant. Here are 9 things I wish passengers would stop doing on airplanes.
items.article: I saw far too many people go to the lavatory barefoot or blast music without headphones. I worked as a flight attendant on long-haul international routes for nearly a decade — and I got an unfiltered, front-row seat to some of the worst passenger etiquette in commercial air travel. Most people want a peaceful trip, but small habits can quickly turn a flight into a nightmare for everyone nearby. Looking back at my years in the sky, here are the main things I wish passengers would stop doing on flights. Depending on the aircraft layout, economy passengers often walked through business class during boarding. I frequently caught people grabbing business-class pillows, premium headphones, or plush blankets on their way back to their seats. Others tried to pack away cabin blankets and safety cards and even pull life vests from under their seats as souvenirs. My crew had to count all those items. Missing life vests meant delaying the flight to replace them, and missing blankets created real supply headaches for our colleagues on the next leg. After the boarding doors closed, I often saw passengers spot an empty business-class seat and try to sneak into it. This almost always happened on long overnight flights when the cabin lights went dim, and people thought we wouldn't notice.

items.key: ai:india formally names 28 places and features in ladakh on official map amid china push | why it matters
items.text: India formally names 28 places and features in Ladakh on official map amid China push | Why it matters
items.article: India has formally named and mapped 28 places and geographical features in Ladakh on official Survey of India maps, following a similar exercise in Arunachal Pradesh. The move comes amid China’s practice of assigning Chinese names to locations in Indian territories. The Centre has formally identified and mapped 28 places and geographical features in Ladakh on the official Survey of India map, the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) said on Friday. The MHA said the exercise was carried out in consultation with the Union Territory administration and is aimed at facilitating the “accurate recognition” of these locations and improving public awareness about them. The move comes after the Centre standardised the names of 27 places and geographical features in Arunachal Pradesh in August this year. The newly standardised names include Zorawar Peak, Kanishka Peak, Atisha Giri, Martand Giri, Rinchen Zangpo, Sakyasri Giri, Marpa Lotsava Ri, Milarepa Kangri, Shiva Ri and Maheshvara Ri. The list also includes Karun Pir, Drak Karpo and Jolmori mountains; Chapchingal Pass and Shachmirk Pass; Parpik and Skamri glaciers; and Shkorga Valley. Other identified geographical features include Brangsa, Kuksel, Dehra Compass, Gogra, Kumarayana Point, Panglung and Shamal Lungpa.
